title: Counting Elements
description: Given an integer array `arr`, count how many elements `x` there are, such that `x + 1` is also in `arr`. If there are duplicates in `arr`, count them separately.

examples.explanation: 1 and 2 are counted cause 2 and 3 are in arr.
No numbers are counted, cause there is no 2, 4, 6, or 8 in arr.

hints: Analyze the constraints and data structures appropriate for Counting Elements.
